summary: Extraction layer for .tex: LocationInfo gains environment/label, ExtractedUnit gains unicode_text; new app/services/extraction/tex.py registered via @register('tex') on pylatexenc (latexwalker + latex2text) emitting per-section, per-environment and display-math units with preamble macro map (newcommand/def/DeclareMathOperator) expansion and unicode rendering; try-import fallback in extraction/__init__.py; requirements.txt gains pylatexenc; tests.
final_report: T17.2 done. base.py: LocationInfo += environment/label (to_dict passes them through, LocationKind literal untouched), ExtractedUnit += unicode_text. New app/services/extraction/tex.py (307 lines) registered @register('tex') via the pdf.py try/except+register_unavailable pattern on pylatexenc 2.11: walks body (after \begin{document}; preamble never emitted; no-document fallback treats top-level nodes as body), emits one unit per section command (part/chapter/section/subsection/subsubsection, kind='section'), per theorem/definition/example/lemma/proposition/corollary/proof/remark and display-math (equation[/*]/align[/*]/alignat/gather/multline) environment (kind='lines', environment normalized star-stripped, label captured, optional [title] prepended as '[Rolle]\n'), and prose between sections as one unit each (markdown.py-style start/end_line at first/last non-blank content). Preamble macro map: no-arg \newcommand{\X}{...}, \def\X{...} (adjacent macro+group node pair), \DeclareMathOperator; inline expansion via re.sub with lambda replacement (fixes re 'bad escape \m' in \mathbb{R} replacement templates) using escaped pattern re.escape('\\'+name)+(?!\w) so \half never matches inside other tokens. unicode_text rendered per unit with LatexNodes2Text.nodelist_to_text on the expanded text (∫/α/ℝ verified). Error result when no units. extraction/__init__.py try-imports tex with register_unavailable fallback; registry test extended with 'tex'. requirements.txt gains pylatexenc (per plan, T17.2 not T17.8). tests/test_extraction_tex.py: 11 tests, all importorskip('pylatexenc') — sections/prose, no-preamble, theorem [Rolle]+label, equation label+unicode ∫, comments+\verb+nested-braces robustness, macro expansion visibility (\mathbb{R} in text, ℝ in unicode), multiline align, α/∫ unicode, empty-doc error, get_extractor('tex') dispatch, no-document-environment fallback. Verified: tests/test_extraction_tex.py + test_extraction.py 21 passed; full offline suite 223 passed (212 baseline + 11 new). Commit 09adae9 on feature/latex-notes. LSP 'possibly unbound' diagnostics in tex.py mirror the pre-existing pdf.py try/except pattern (T15 note). TASK STATUS: T17.2 -> done.
